scenes.text: The light in your eye left the Sun eight minutes ago.
scenes.art_prompt: the Sun blazing in space with visible rays streaming toward a small blue Earth, cinematic

scenes.text: You are always looking at the past. Never the present.
scenes.art_prompt: a person on a hillside at dusk, sunlight arriving, timeline of light rendered subtly behind

scenes.text: The nearest star? Its light is four years old.
scenes.art_prompt: a distant bright star against deep space, faint path of light travelling toward viewer

scenes.text: The farthest galaxy you can see with your eyes is two and a half million years old.
scenes.art_prompt: a faint spiral galaxy in the night sky above a dark mountain ridge, awe and distance

scenes.text:
Some of that light left before humans existed.
You are the first to ever see it arrive.
scenes.art_prompt: countless distant galaxies across the void, a lone observer tiny beneath them, wonder
Earth small and blue under an enormous starry sky, quiet and final wide shot
